issues.description: Default base image string duplicated in four locations with no single source of truth.
issues.detail: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE is defined in pipeline.py, hardcoded again as the fallback in Commands.ts (`return 'python:3.12'`), redefined in CellMetadataEditor.tsx, and still appears as a literal in nb_function_template.jinja2's `or` chain history. The invariant 'one canonical default' is violated; a future bump to python:3.13 will require touching multiple files and will silently disagree if one is missed.

issues.description: Behavior change in _set_base_image silently shifts semantics from 'let kfp choose' to 'force python:3.12'.
issues.detail: Previously `self.base_image = ""` deferred to kfp's default image when pod introspection failed. Now it forces python:3.12. The loop/branch invariant changed: the empty-string sentinel meaning 'unspecified, defer downstream' is gone. This affects pipelines that relied on kfp's default and is not stated in the diff's intent (UI display).

issues.description: RPC handler imports DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE inside the function body rather than at module top.
issues.detail: `from kale.pipeline import DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE` inside get_default_base_image pays an import-resolution cost on every RPC call and obscures the dependency. Since compiler.py already imports it at top-level, the same pattern should apply here. A literate reader expects module dependencies stated up front.

issues.description: Button width '5%' with text 'IMAGE' is a magic constant that will not render predictably.
issues.detail: A 5% width on a button containing the word 'IMAGE' is almost certainly wrong and depends on parent container width. Either the constant is unmeasured (premature layout micro-tuning) or it is a typo for a larger value. State the intended sizing rule or let MUI size the button to content.

issues.description: createBaseImageText now always renders, changing inline-metadata layout invariant without comment.
issues.detail: Previously the component returned '' when no baseImage was set; now it always renders a paragraph showing the resolved default plus '(default)'. This is a deliberate UX change but the reader cannot tell from the diff whether downstream layout (sibling ordering swapped with createLimitsText) was intentional. A one-line literate comment explaining the new invariant would help.

issues.description: Fallback chain `step.config.base_image or base_image or default_base_image` lacks stated precedence rationale.
issues.detail: The Jinja template, the dialog placeholder, and InlineMetadata's effectiveImage all encode the same three-level fallback (step, pipeline, default) but independently. A reader cannot verify they agree without tracing all three. Factor the precedence into one named helper and comment the invariant: step > pipeline > default.

review.summary: UNDER-AUDITED and NEEDS-LITERATE-COMMENT. The feature mostly works but introduces a 'default base image' concept that is duplicated in at least four places (Python constant, RPC body, TS fallback literal, TS constant) with no single source of truth — a future version bump will require coordinated edits and will silently desync if one is missed. The change in pipeline.py from empty-string-defer to forced python:3.12 is a behavior change worth calling out explicitly; the empty sentinel previously meant 'let kfp decide' and that invariant is gone. Layout details (5% button width, reordering of inline metadata paragraphs) read as unmeasured. None of this is wrong asymptotically; the issues are clarity, invariant statement, and DRY around the precedence rule step > pipeline > default.
